text:
aj: Follow-up from PM: multiple partials/timeouts this month. New pattern noticed: graceful shutdowns during scale-down leave half-closed TCP sockets and clients don't always resume -> partial responses. Need heartbeat + resume robustness and short-term mitigations.

sasha: Observed three repeat clusters at ~03:00 UTC correlated with scale-down events. Symptoms: server sends FIN, client sees stream close mid-response, some SDKs open a new stream without resume token. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/streaming/stream-health (panel: shutdown_partial_spikes).

noah: Proposal: add a server-side pre-drain handshake before socket close: send "stream:pre-drain" event and wait up to 500ms for active streams to finish, otherwise mark for fast-drain. This will help reduce mid-token closes. I can prototype. ETA 2026-04-04.

anya: Short-term client mitigation: SDKs should treat unexpected FIN during active message as "try resume" instead of immediate new stream. I'll push patch to JS + Python. ETA 2026-04-06. Also will add config flag enable_backpressure=true.

darren: Runtime change: add heartbeat keepalive on long-lived streams (30s interval) and detect half-closed sockets. If client doesn't ack heartbeat within 2 intervals, mark as stale and trigger resume expiry. I'll own runtime + metric keepalive_miss_count. ETA 2026-04-03.

aj: Ops ask: can we run a targeted 72h canary in us-west-2 with both heartbeat and pre-drain enabled (10% traffic)? Need SRE monitoring runbook.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: refs/heads/noah/pre-drain -> 2026-04-05T02:00Z. Rollout policy: 10% for 6h -> 30% for 12h -> 100% with 2h health checks. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/pull/458.

ops-bot: Noted. Oncall checklist: monitor partial_response_rate, keepalive_miss_count, resume_attempt_success. Escalate to sre-lead if partial_response_rate > 0.4% for 10m.

sasha: Let's add a golden test in CI: simulate scale-down during mid-response and assert resume path works within 1s. Who can add?

darren: I'll add the CI harness and a unit test that injects a delayed FIN during token emission. Plan: two tests (nominal, injected-FIN). ETA 2026-04-08.

anya: SDK change details for QA: expose resume_attempts metric and provide API: client.resume(stream_id, resume_token). Example: 
```
const s = client.stream({resume: true});
// on unexpected close
await s.resume();
```
Include this in quickstart.

noah: For pre-drain, also add a fast-fail toggle for emergency rollbacks. We'll wire a runtime feature flag. infra-bot, can you add rollout flag?

infra-bot: Feature flag created: streaming.pre_drain.enabled (default=false). Toggle API: https://flags.redwood.ai/streaming.

aj: Owners + due dates (consolidated): 1) Pre-drain prototype (noah) by 2026-04-04; 2) Keepalive + metrics (darren) by 2026-04-03; 3) SDK resume + examples (anya) by 2026-04-06; 4) Canary (ops) 2026-04-05 -> 72h; 5) CI golden tests (darren) by 2026-04-08; 6) Runbook update (aj) by 2026-04-07. I'll follow up in 48h.

noah: I'll open a follow-up doc with design notes and edgecases: fencing between drain and resume, ordering guarantees. Link: docs.redwood.ai/internal/streaming/pre-drain-design (draft).

anya: QA instructions: to reproduce locally, run runtime in dev mode, fire a long prompt, then send SIGTERM to runtime and observe resume. Repro command: 
```
# start local runtime
make dev-runtime
# run repro script
python tools/repro/stream_close_repro.py --long-prompt
```

aj: Scheduling: Maria from SRE is out this week so aj will run the initial canary checks and post hourly status to #eng-sre. If partial_response_rate spikes, revert feature flag.

ops-bot: Canary monitoring plan attached: panels to watch: partial_response_rate, resume_attempt_success_rate, keepalive_miss_count. Alert thresholds: partial_response_rate > 0.4% (10m), keepalive_miss_rate > 1% (5m).

sasha: Suggest adding a recurring monthly "Stream fragility review" to capture patterns across months (rotate owners). I'll add draft calendar once PRs merge.

aj: Closing note: once all infra + SDK changes are live and canary stable for 72h we mark actions resolved and update the original postmortem. If anyone needs to reassign, ping me here.

(ops-bot/system): Incident postmortem updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/streaming-scale-down-partial-2026 (linked)
